Job Description

Job Title: Sr. Regional Product Support Manager – Mining/Oil & Gas

Working Pattern: Full Time

Working location: Working from Home US

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Why Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

Position Summary

The Regional Product Support Manager (RPSM) provides second-level service support across the assigned region, working closely with the distribution network, OEM partners, customers, and internal teams in the Mining/Oil & Gas industry. This role helps resolve customer complaints, supports warranty-related decisions, and drives effective communication and follow-through on field service issues. The RPSM also conducts field inspections, prepares service-related presentations, and uses company protocols to identify failure causes and help reduce future incidents. The RSM would be mainly responsible for covering the Southwest region of the United States with frequent travel to Utah, New Mexico, Texas, and other states in that region.

What you will be doing

  • Provide second-level service support to the distribution network while maintaining clear and regular communication between the field, customers, and internal teams.
  • Partner with the distribution network to quickly address customer complaints, resolve service concerns, and strengthen the overall customer experience.
  • Prepare and deliver professional service-related presentations to customers, management, and internal staff.
  • Oversee and perform field inspections of failed parts to identify primary cause of failure, document findings through company reporting protocols, and support actions that reduce future incidents.
  • Make informed recommendations and decisions on next steps for warranty-related situations while following established company procedures and protocols.
  • Travel up to 75% within the assigned area of responsibility, with some international travel as required

.Basic Requirements:

  • 9+ years of service support experience in lieu of a degree, OR
  • Associate degree in engineering or business with 7+ years of service support experience, OR
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business with 5+ years of service support service experience, OR
  • Master’s degree in engineering or business with 3+ years of service support experience, OR
  • JD/PhD in engineering or business with 1+ years of service support experience
  • In order to be eligible for consideration, you must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent. Resident Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S without sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience providing technical or product support for diesel or gas engines, power generation systems, heavy equipment, or related industrial products.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to present service findings, recommendations, and technical information to customers, distributors, and leadership.
  • Experience investigating field failures, identifying root cause, documenting findings, and recommending corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents.
  • Knowledge of warranty, service escalation, or claims processes within an aftersales, distribution, OEM, or dealer network environment.
  • Experience supporting customers in mining, oil and gas, power generation, or other mission-critical industrial markets.

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalisation and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.

Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics. We are committed to providing a respectful and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued and everyone can thrive.

Infinite Potential

Closing date: August 14th, 2026


Job Posting Date

23 Jul 2026; 00:07


Pay Range

$122,741 - $199,454-Annually

Location:

Working from home

Benefits

Rolls-Royce provides a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that includes base pay and a discretionary bonus plan. Eligible employees may have the opportunity to enroll in other benefits, including health, dental, vision, disability, life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance; a flexible spending account; a health savings account; a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match; Employee Assistance Program; Paid Time Off; certain paid holidays; paid parental and family care leave; tuition reimbursement; and a long-term incentive plan. The options available to an employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as date of hire, and employment type.

The Business UnitPower Systems of Rolls-Royce provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalization and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that are even cleaner and smarter and thus provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These clean and technologically-advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

At Mindera, we build resilient, high-throughput software. We are expanding our core engineering teams as part of a long-term partnership. We are seeking a Senior Tech Program Manager to join our team and play a key role in one of our projects within the betting industry.

This is a pivotal position where your mission will be to ensure the successful execution of the project, managing scope, budget, schedule, and risks, while keeping our teams supported, focused, and delivering with quality.

You'll own the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-risk programs spanning multiple teams and disciplines. You'll lead program-level planning, sequencing, and dependency management — keeping delivery on track against agreed outcomes, timelines, and budgets, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product outcomes and technical quality.

You're pragmatic and hands-on: someone who removes pressure from teams, unblocks issues, and keeps delivery moving. You act as a point of escalation, giving senior stakeholders clear visibility and confidence, and role-model strong delivery practice across the organization.

On other hand, at Mindera we encourage the use of AI to assist with coding and related tasks. We find a persons skill in engineering and software craft, has a big impact long term successful delivery, with or without AI. Our goal in the interview process is to understand the candidates knowledge and skill with engineering. If you need to, or plan to use AI, please be transparent with us when you're using it, to avoid issues and misunderstandings that can either: impact your chance of securing the role or impact your success at Mindera.

National and international expected traveling time varies according to project/client and organizational needs: 0%-15% estimated.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end program management process, from scope definition to delivery, ensuring goals, timelines, and budgets are met.
  • Lead program-level sequencing and roadmap planning, integrating delivery across teams based on Product and Engineering roadmaps.
  • Maintain a clear delivery plan, tracking progress and adapting as circumstances change.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks and dependencies, escalating blockers as needed.
  • Lead and organize multidisciplinary teams, promoting collaboration, focus, and accountability.
  • Negotiate and manage client and stakeholder expectations through transparent communication across business, product, and technology.
  • Provide clear, data-led visibility of program progress, delivery health, and risks to senior stakeholders.
  • Support financial tracking and spend visibility at program level.
  • Manage transition of program into business-as-usual, ensuring proper handover to operational teams.
  • Reinforce agile and DevOps delivery discipline, cadence, and execution practices across teams.
  • Where required, line manage and develop TPMs and Associate TPMs, building a high-performance team culture.
  • Coach TPMs and contribute to the wider Delivery/TPM community.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Project/Delivery/Technical Program Manager in software development, leading complex, multi-team initiatives end-to-end.
  • Senior program management experience, including reporting to senior stakeholders on OKRs and KPIs.
  • Technical understanding of architecture, development, or software delivery.
  • Strong sequencing, planning, and prioritisation skills across teams and product areas.
  • Advanced risk and dependency management, with confidence to escalate and drive resolution.
  • Confidence negotiating with clients and managing expectations.
  • Experience leading multiple teams in dynamic, fast-moving settings.
  • Experienced in the Retail sector from an engineering & data background is a plus.
  • A pragmatic, results-oriented mindset focused on delivery and outcomes.
  • Ability to stay calm and shield teams from unnecessary stress.
  • Financial tracking awareness, supporting budget control and value-driven decisions.
  • Agile and DevOps delivery expertise.
  • Coaching and mentoring capability, contributing to delivery maturity.

Benefits

The Things We Really Care About:

    • Flexible working hours
    • Mindera Annual Trip, Sports, and sharing groups to connect and have fun!
    • Training & conferences, create your own training plan

Most of all, You get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together in a politics-free environment. Our culture reflects our lean and self-organization attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way, and talk to everyone to enhance communication. Freedom and Responsibility go hand in hand, and we value commitment, feedback, and empathy.

About Mindera

At Mindera we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

Software Engineering Applications, including Web and Mobile, are at the core of what we do at Mindera.

We partner with our clients to understand their products and deliver high-performance, resilient, and scalable software systems that create an impact on their users and businesses across the world.

You get to work with a bunch of great people, where the whole team owns the project together.

Our culture reflects our lean and self management attitude. We encourage our colleagues to take risks, make decisions, work in a collaborative way and talk to everyone to enhance communication.

We are proud of our work and we love to learn all and everything while navigating through an Agile, Lean and collaborative environment.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Lakewood, Ohio

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

At Verra, we've created a culture of flexibility + autonomy. You'll be able to work with remote teams from diverse countries and industries. Wherever possible, we aim to find mutually agreeable solutions for international hiring.

Verra is a global leader helping to tackle the world’s most intractable environmental and social challenges. As a mission-driven non-profit organization, Verra is committed to helping reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve livelihoods and protect natural resources across the private and public sectors. We support climate action and sustainable development with standards, tools and programs that credibly, transparently and robustly assess environmental and social impacts and enable funding for sustaining and scaling up projects that verifiably deliver these benefits. We work in any arena where we see a need for clear standards, a role for market-based mechanisms, and an opportunity to generate significant environmental and social value.

Verra manages a portfolio of standards, including the:

  • Climate, Community & Biodiversity (CCB) Standards -- to identify projects that simultaneously address climate change, support local communities and smallholders, and conserve biodiversity.
  • Plastic Waste Reduction Program -- to enable robust impact assessment of new or scaled-up waste recovery and recycling projects around the globe.

What You Wil Do:

We are seeking an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Leader to build and lead our enterprise IAM function. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role is responsible for IAM strategy, architecture, delivery, and operations across workforce, customer, and non-human identities.

This leader will define the IAM vision and roadmap, oversee key identity transformation initiatives, manage vendors and delivery partners, and lead a globally distributed team in a complex, matrixed environment.

Strategy, Vision & Organizational Leadership

  • Define and lead the enterprise IAM strategy, operating model, and roadmap aligned to business, risk, and regulatory priorities. Build and scale the IAM organization to include team structure and hiring plans.

  • Partner across Cybersecurity, IT, HR, Legal, Privacy, Risk, Internal Audit, and business teams to deliver consistent identity outcomes.

  • Oversee major IAM transformation initiatives, including program execution and budget accountability.

  • Establish metrics and reporting to demonstrate program maturity, business value, and risk reduction.

Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)

  • Lead the design and maturity of Identity Governance and Administration capabilities, including lifecycle management, access requests, certifications, role management, and separation of duties.

  • Drive the strategy, implementation, and maturation of enterprise IGA capabilities using platforms such as SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, or similar solutions.

  • Advance least-privilege and Zero Trust principles across enterprise applications, platforms, and cloud environments.

  • Oversee identity lifecycle management for workforce, contractors, partners, and non-human identities.

Privileged Access Management (PAM)

  • Lead the strategy and maturity of the firm’s Privileged Access Management program, including vaulting, credential management, session controls, and privileged access governance.

  • Provide strategic leadership for PAM capabilities and related tooling, including platforms such as Delinea, CyberArk, or similar solutions.

  • Establish standards for privileged access, secrets management, and just-in-time elevation across human and machine identities.

  • Reduce standing privilege across hybrid environments and track progress through measurable controls.

Authentication, SSO & Federation

  • Lead enterprise authentication and access capabilities, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, federation, and modern authentication methods.

  • Support modern identity and access patterns through technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID and related federation and access governance capabilities.

  • Support secure identity patterns for employees, clients, partners, and external platforms as needed.

Cloud & Workload Identity

  • Drive identity standards for cloud and workload access across Guidehouse’s hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams to embed identity and access controls into platforms and delivery processes.

  • Establish guardrails and monitoring for entitlements and permissions across enterprise technology environments.

Risk, Compliance & Audit

  • Align IAM capabilities to security, compliance, and audit requirements across applicable regulatory and control frameworks.

  • Partner with compliance and audit stakeholders to support control evidence, remediation, and sustainable governance processes.

  • Support identity requirements for both internal operations and client-serving environments as needed.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning IAM architecture, engineering, operations, and governance.

  • Build a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Represent the IAM function with senior leadership and key stakeholders across the enterprise.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree and minimum 12 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity with at least 8+ years focused on Identity & Access Management, and 7+ years in a people-leadership capacity or 16 years of equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree.

  • Proven experience building or maturing an enterprise IAM function in a complex, global organization.

  • Demonstrated success leading in a matrixed environment and partnering across technology, security, and business teams.

  • Strong experience with modern IAM technologies and concepts, including IGA, PAM, SSO, MFA, federation, and lifecycle management, with hands-on experience leading or supporting platforms such as SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Delinea, CyberArk, and similar tools.

  • Experience leading complex, multi-year IAM transformation programs with cross-functional teams and external partners.

  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to IAM programs.

  • Experience supporting identity requirements in regulated environments, including public sector or highly governed industries.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • U.S. Citizenship required. Must reside in the United States.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Experience in a professional services or other complex enterprise environment.

  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or IAM-related certifications.

The annual salary range for this position is $171,000.00-$285,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

You will report directly to Operations Manager.

raw.description:
HealthSnap (healthsnap.io) empowers patients and their physicians to improve health outcomes using an innovative platform for modern, proactive patient care. We help healthcare organizations easily manage chronic conditions remotely, and deliver personalized patient experiences when it's needed most.

Be part of an organization built on teamwork, innovation, mutual respect, and equity for all. We believe in the power of prevention over treatment, after our co-founders experienced how modern healthcare failed their loved ones, they knew there had to be a better way. We believe that every patient deserves to receive the right care, at the right time, and in the right location - regardless of their condition or status.

We lead with empathy above all else, and place the patient at the center of everything we do. Working at HealthSnap means being part of a family and a team where if you win, we all win, no matter how big or small the accomplishment. We take ownership - and lead with empathy - and expect each employee to recognize that real patients rely on HealthSnap every day.

Are you ready to use your expertise to help patients achieve unprecedented improvements in their health?

As pioneers of the next generation of healthcare, we are seeking a highly motivated, compassionate candidate dedicated to clinical excellence for our Care Navigator position to directly impact patient health through HealthSnap’s remote care solutions.

We are hiring New York-certified LPN/LVNs to support patients who are enrolled in chronic care management and/or remote patient monitoring programs. This is done in partnership with the patients’ care team which may include primary or specialty physician practices or healthcare systems. Successful candidates will bring experience in educating patients on chronic diseases such as hypertension and diabetes. This is a full-time 40-hours-per-week role Monday-Friday.

As a Care Navigator, you will be trained in HealthSnap’s remote patient monitoring platform and will be responsible for communicating with enrolled patients in conjunction with the patient’s care team. Care Navigators typically have an assigned group of patients for which the Care Navigator is responsible for reaching throughout the month. Care Navigators also assist with other patients or patient tasks as assigned.

Above all else, you will play an essential role in establishing a relationship with assigned patients that allows you to empower them to manage their chronic illnesses and improve their health.

** New York Nursing License Required **

** Additional Compact Nursing License Preferred **

Competencies/Job Duties

  • High level of computer literacy, comfortable learning and using digital health portal
  • Conducts virtual consultations with patients, focusing on patient education for lifestyle and behavior as it relates to clinical status
  • Patient load assigned based on practice need
  • Following approved partner workflows, reviews and responds to remotely transmitted patient data such as blood pressure, blood glucose, weight, and pulse oximetry.
  • Documents patient communication in patient records
  • Responsible for assisting patients in setting up their device
  • Works collaboratively with other team members when help is needed
  • Able to work independently
  • Possess excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Engaging personality with the desire to learn new topics in lifestyle medicine
  • Ability to acquire, interpret, and convey clinical research
  • Pays attention to detail for each task
  • Additional duties as assigned

Requirements

  • A current, valid, and in good standing New York Nursing License (LPN/LVN)
  • A current, valid, and in good standing Multistate/Compact Nursing License (Preferred)
  • 3+ years of experience in cardiology practice (preferred) or primary care practice, home care, or chronic care management
  • Experience in remote monitoring and/or virtual care management program(s) (preferred)
  • Employee must have a HIPAA-compliant area to work remotely
  • Employee must have a distraction-free work environment
  • Employee must provide reliable internet of 100mbps download minimum and 10mbps upload minimum

Benefits

HealthSnap offers a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Career Advancement Opportunities, and the Ability to Work Remotely.

Compensation

Compensation is based on candidate's experience and the region in which the candidate lives.

Bonus

You have the opportunity to earn a quarterly performance-based bonus of up to $6,000 annually.

Location - Remote

We embrace diversity and are an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. No matter your background, your orientation, or your identity expression, if you are passionate about improving the future of healthcare through lifestyle change, we want to hear from you!

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $135k - $160k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Attleboro, Massachusetts

Salary:

135K - 160K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $135,000 – $160,000 / year

Highlights:

Proyectos globales de alto impacto. Remoto, acompañamiento 1:1 de HRBP y desafíos técnicos de alta complejidad. Cultura de alto rendimiento e innovación.

raw.description:
About Diversified:

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.

What to Expect:

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.

Senior Vice President, Global Marketing The Senior Vice President of Global Marketing serves as a strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and amplifying Diversified’s brand presence globally. This role drives enterprise-wide marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with the company’s growth priorities, client experience, and market position. Acting as a catalyst for innovation, the SVP transforms insights into action—building a marketing function that connects Diversified’s purpose, products, and people through compelling storytelling and measurable results. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, the SVP of Global Marketing partners closely with the executive leadership team to define and execute the company’s global marketing vision, enhancing engagement across clients, partners, and associates. Key Accountabilities Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Define and evolve Diversified’s global brand architecture to reflect its mission of creating the unforgettable.
  • Strengthen brand consistency across all channels, geographies, and business segments.
  • Serve as brand steward and storyteller, connecting marketing outcomes to strategic business priorities.

Growth and Market Expansion

  • Develop integrated marketing strategies to support enterprise growth, product launches, and market expansion.
  • Lead marketing intelligence, competitive insights, and client research to inform business decisions and new opportunities.
  • Partner with the Chief Revenue Officer to align marketing with pipeline development, demand generation, and client retention goals.

Product & Solutions Marketing

  • Own solutions and portfolio marketing, developing differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions across Diversified’s offering portfolio and translating them into sales-ready narratives and enablement.
  • Establish Diversified as a market leader in AI-powered environments, articulating the company’s agentic-AI vision and proprietary IP to clients, partners, analysts, and the broader market.
  • Lead go-to-market launches for new and expanding offerings, including managed services and other recurring-revenue solutions, coordinating messaging, enablement, and campaigns across the commercial organization.
  • Drive competitive intelligence and market differentiation, equipping sales with the insights and content needed to win against alternatives and expand within accounts.
  • Build and manage analyst, influencer, and industry relations to strengthen third-party validation and thought leadership across AV, broadcast, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.

Demand Generation & Account-Based Marketing

  • Own the demand generation engine end to end, including target market assessment, propensity-to-buy analysis, and buyer persona identification to focus investment on the highest-value segments and accounts.
  • Design and operate mature, multi-touch Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs in close partnership with sales, orchestrating marketing plays against named accounts and pipeline targets.
  • Deploy industry-leading marketing technology and data-driven digital campaigns to power proactive, personalized outreach across the full buyer journey.
  • Build closed-loop measurement that ties demand generation and ABM activity to marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline, conversion, and revenue.

Digital and Content Strategy

  • Oversee all digital channels, content marketing, and campaign execution to drive awareness, engagement, and lead conversion.
  • Elevate Diversified’s presence through creative storytelling, client case studies, events, and media relations.
  • Introduce new technologies and analytics to measure Return on Marketing Investment (ROMI) and optimize spend effectiveness.

Communications and Culture Alignment

  • Lead all external marketing and communications initiatives that strengthen Diversified’s presence in the marketplace.
  • Promote Diversified’s core values and its brand promise of creating the unforgettable through consistent storytelling across global campaigns, media, and events.
  • Partner with executive leadership to shape the company’s external voice, ensuring alignment between brand positioning, public relations, and client engagement strategies.
  • Drive visibility through industry thought leadership, press relations, sponsorships, and partnerships that reinforce Diversified’s global reputation for excellence.

Operational Excellence and Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global marketing organization that combines creativity with operational discipline.
  • Establish measurable KPIs for marketing performance, pipeline contribution, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Manage budgets, agency relationships, and vendor partnerships to maximize value and scalability.

Qualifications Education & Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, ideally within technology, professional services, or related industries.
  • Proven track record in building and scaling global marketing functions across diverse markets.
  • Strong expertise in brand management, digital strategy, demand generation, and communications.
  • Demonstrated experience building and running mature Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs at scale, from target account selection through orchestrated, multi-channel engagement.
  • Deep demand generation expertise spanning target market assessment, propensity-to-buy modeling, persona development, and segmentation to prioritize investment.
  • Hands-on command of a modern marketing technology and analytics stack (marketing automation, CRM, intent and ABM platforms) and its application to proactive digital outreach.
  • Proven product, solutions, or portfolio marketing experience, including positioning, messaging, competitive differentiation, and the go-to-market launch of complex technology or services offerings.
  • Experience positioning emerging or AI-enabled solutions and shaping category narratives, ideally within technology, systems integration, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into actionable marketing plans that drive measurable growth.
  • Global experience with cross-cultural communication and team leadership preferred.

Skills & Attributes

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen, with experience managing budgets and vendor relationships.
  • Adept at leading through influence and building trust across senior leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational demands.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and discretion in handling confidential matters.

Key Success Metrics

  • Increase global brand awareness and market recognition across key regions.
  • Drive measurable revenue impact through marketing-sourced leads and pipeline growth.
  • Deliver high-performing campaigns with strong engagement and ROMI.
  • Elevate external visibility through thought leadership, media presence, and industry recognition.
  • Build and lead a high-performing global marketing team with clear accountability and results.

What We Offer:

We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work-life balance:

  • Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs

◦ HSA & HRA company contributions

  • Dental coverage, including orthodontic benefits, and vision plans

Company-paid benefits ◦ Basic Life, AD&D ◦ Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance ◦ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Generous paid time off — 3 weeks PTO plus company holidays and floating holidays
  • 401k with company match
  • Paid maternity leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • A wide range of voluntary benefits including Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Pet Insurance, Homeowners and Auto Insurance, Supplemental Life and AD&D coverage, and Legal Services
  • Commuter benefits

Health Plan Request Bench Release of Information Specialist III

Summary of Position:

The Health Plan Request (HPR) Bench Release of Information Specialist (ROIS) III is responsible for handling HPR ROIS tasks with precision, efficiency, and compliance using productivity-driven metrics. This position involves processing audit-related ROI requests, ensuring accurate documentation, and maintaining compliance with HIPAA regulations. The HPR Bench ROIS III is fluent in multiple electronic medical record (EMR) systems and is comfortable navigating various platforms to retrieve and organize requested records and maintains a productivity level of 90% or higher on all sites they support. This role is primarily focused (90%) on processing medical record requests while dedicating 10% of their time to training, mentoring, documentation, and other administrative tasks as well as ensuring they can fulfill all client-specific onboarding and access requirements. As a subject matter expert, the HPR Bench ROIS III provides coaching and guidance to team members to ensure best practices are followed.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Process medical ROI requests related to health plan audits quickly and accurately in compliance with HIPAA regulations
  • Utilize Verisma software applications to input, manage, and track medical records
  • Organize and retrieve records within multiple EMR systems, ensuring all documentation is properly structured and complete
  • Interpret medical records and Records Requests to correspond to specific audit measures
  • Maintain a high level of productivity, efficiency, and accuracy, meeting company standards and performance metrics
  • Prioritize workload effectively and work independently while meeting productivity goals
  • Maintain necessary background, drug and health screening as required by accounts being supported
  • Communicate effectively within the HPR team and in a cross-functional manner, as necessary
  • Attain an expert-level understanding of client-specific expectations across multiple accounts while ensuring compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, state regulations, and company policies
  • Serve as an escalation point for HIPAA-related release issues and complex requests
  • Utilize Verisma’s reference materials and compliance guidelines to maintain confidentiality and accuracy, assisting with update as needed
  • Serve as a mentor, assist in training and coaching to ensure process consistency
  • Assist with queue management and provide coverage, as needed
  • Attend and actively participate in training sessions, workflow updates and team meetings, as required
  • Assist managers and directors with interviewing, training, and mentoring new associates ensuring knowledge transfer and consistency in processes
  • Document and report process improvements to leadership while providing feedback to the development team on system enhancements to optimize workflow efficiency
  • Maintain all necessary background checks, drug screenings, health screenings and access requirements to serve on the Bench
  • Provide exemplary customer service, maintaining a professional and friendly approach in all interactions
  • Perform other related duties, as assigned, to ensure the effective operation of the department and the company
  • Live by and promote Verisma Core Values

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; some college preferred
  • RHIT certification preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in medical records, Release of Information (ROI), or Health Information Management (HIM) with expertise in supporting multiple clients and processing audit requests
  • Knowledge of HIPAA and state regulations related to the release of protected health information
  • Must be able to maintain all necessary background checks, drug screenings, health screenings and access requirements to serve on the Bench
  • Clerical or office experience with data entry, document management and proficiency in using general office equipment
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel; Comfortable navigating multiple EMR systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Ability to train and mentor colleagues on complex requests and workflows
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational and time management skills with keen attention to detail
  • Strong ability to work independently while meeting productivity expectations.
  • Ability to effectively multi-task or change projects, as needed
  • Prior remote experience, preferred

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Business Informatics Support Data Engineer to join our team! The Business Informatics Support Data Engineer is a highly skilled, collaborative, and technical position responsible for the development and maintenance of reporting systems for Trillium. This role is dedicated to supporting business operations through the development of scalable data solutions using SQL, SSRS, and Power BI. This role will be a primary in the design and support of the Data Warehouse. In addition to technical development, this position will be responsible for maintaining up-to-date documentation in the team wiki and providing mentorship and support to other Business Informatics and Business reporting team members, as needed.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Participate in the design and support of the Data Warehouse.
  • Collaborate with business units to understand data needs and translate them into effective reporting solutions by gathering requirements and delivering high-quality data solutions that support operational and strategic goals.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize SSRS reports and Power BI dashboards to provide actionable insights.
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from various sources.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all reporting platforms.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)https://www.myncretirement.gov/systems-funds/local-governmental-employees-retirement-system-lgers/lgers-handbook
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Associate’s degree and four (4) years of experience in any of the following areas: Information Technology/MIS, Mathematics (Actuarial/ Statistics), Data Analytics, Engineering Sciences, Business, Healthcare Administration, Human Service field, healthcare claims environment and reporting development, n-tier and web-based system development and support with strong technical knowledge in the specialized areas of application system programming, including software and tools including; SQL Server 2016 or above, SQL, My SQL, Azure DevOps, Source Control, SSRS, SSIS, SSMS, Visual Studio 2016 or above, C# and Microsoft.NET Framework 4.0 or above. Requires certification. Applicable certification(s) may be substituted to equivalent degree and experience requirements; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education/experience.
  • Two-year degrees require certification.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within United States.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Information Technology/MIS, Mathematics (Actuarial/Statistics), Data Analytics, Engineering Sciences, Business, Healthcare Administration, or Human Service field.
  • Recent experience with SQL database management and development (i.e. Power BI, Analytical, R, Python, Visual Studio, and/or SSRS).
  • Knowledge or experience with one or more of the following technologies: NoSQL, Snowflake, Databricks, Mongo, or Hadoop.
  • Applicable certification(s) including Microsoft data systems certifications, CSTP, ISTQB, ASTQB, MTA, MCSA, MCSD, MCSE, ITIL v3, Power BI, as well as INFORMS, IIBA, AWS, Azure, or equivalent certifications will be accepted.

Deadline for Application:August 13, 2026@11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Toledo, Ohio

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

raw.title: Senior Assistant Managing Editor
raw.excerpt: Job PurposeTo proactively develop journal in order to deliver growth in terms of published content.
raw.description:
Job Purpose

To proactively develop journal in order to deliver growth in terms of published content. To build relationships with authors and editors such that journal meet or exceed their published content targets. Depending on journal needs, this position might oversee 1-2 direct reports who are working on similar tasks and/or projects. Troubleshoot and display the ability to deal with difficult situations with maturity and calmness. Maintain high-quality, proactive communication and excellent relationships with a global team.

Key Accountabilities

Scope of work includes, but is not limited to, the following:

1. Manage and maintain the administrative process of a Sage journal (Sage Open) through the Sage

Track site.

2. Complete agreed number of advanced article processing tasks each month.

3. Maintain positive work relationships and top-quality communication with journal editors, authors,
reviewers, and Sage staff throughout the world.

4. Work together with various contacts in the Sage US and Sage UK Offices (i.e. editorial, marketing,
production, etc.) to utilize the Sage Track sites and facilitate the growth and progress of the

journal.

5. Hold video/audio conferences with US and UK colleagues after the usual office hours. Maintain

editorial knowledge and proficiency.

6. Maintain editorial knowledge and proficiency.

Job Functions and Responsibilities

1. Supervise 1-2 Peer Review Associates with each individual handling the workload as per the

work allocation plan.

2. Manage relationships with individual team members in a professional manner.

3. Evaluate the efficacy of processes periodically and suggest corrective action where required.

4. Complete advanced peer review tasks, such as external editor/reviewer selection and decision approvals. This position also support other work like initial manuscript editorial quality checks as needed.

5. Help enforce journal standards for ethics and research quality across a range of complex cases.

6. Keep informed of Sage Research Integrity Group guidelines and industry ethics news. Help anticipate and address ethics issues.

7. Help identify problem areas or areas of improvement for their journals and oversee
strategic plan of action to improve turnaround times and maintain quality standards.

8. Escalate process, human resource issues to the Reporting Managers in a timely manner.

Others

1. Meet or exceed the productivity standards for the SAGE Open PRA position.

2. Communicate in a professional and personable manner with editors, authors, reviewers, and other SAGE staff on any issues concerning their journal.

3. Troubleshoot issues involving the journal and/or SAGE Track site as required.

4. Closely monitor manuscript progress as manuscripts move through the various steps of the peer review process.

5. Please forward your supervisor any communications that you receive from editors/authors that are tense or volatile in nature, also, please send your supervisor any positive words and praise you receive from editors and authors.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Include, but not limited to, the following:

  • A minimum of a Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant Humanities and Social Sciences (HSS) field; PhD preferred.
  • Excellent English verbal and written business communication skills.
  • Computer skills, including working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Power BI, Outlook, and Power Point
  • Outstanding interpersonal relationship building and employee coaching and development skills.
  • Knowledge of the Peer Review functions, operation and decision making, in Publishing Industry will be a must.
  • Organization skills and attention to detail

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

raw.description:
Location: Seattle, Washington preferred but open to remote

Role Summary

As a demand planning lead for GCG and its portfolio companies, this role owns the end-to-end assortment planning process across the store development portfolio and partners with our internal and customer-based design teams to shape demand planning processes. This position is designed to align cross-functional stakeholders on priorities, risks, product lifecycle transitions, and inventory outcomes while improving planning capabilities and decision-making across the business.

The role includes traveling to customer locations to support on-site project success. As a member of the GCG team, the Demand Planning Lead is responsible for exemplifying the company guiding principles and fostering our company culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve processes to shape demand in partnership with Concepts and Design teams.
  • Own the end-to-end assortment planning process across the store development portfolio.
  • Lead monthly assortment reviews, aligning cross-functional stakeholders on priorities and risks.
  • Manage product end-of-life transitions to minimize write-off and optimize inventory outcomes.
  • Develop and lead ramp-down strategy plans with other planning partners.
  • Drive product lifecycle management, overseeing item transitions from introduction through exit to optimize performance and minimize financial risk.
  • Deliver proposed order analytics that inform forecasting, sourcing, and inventory decisions.
  • Develop consumption tools and scalable communication processes to enable visibility and inventory depletion across stakeholders and design markets.
  • Partner with Finance, Coffeehouse Integration, and Supply Chain to drive alignment and improve decision-making.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to strengthen planning capabilities and outcomes.
  • Travel to customer site to ensure project is progressing as expected

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of supply chain experience with demand planning, inventory management, and forecasting.

·Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Ability to identify and implement process improvement opportunities with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Experience implementing planning processes.
  • Strong analytical curiosity with the ability to dive into data and turn insights into business decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence a broad range of audiences, including senior leaders.

·Assortment management experience.

Preferred Profile

The strongest candidates will combine supply chain planning depth with strong cross-functional communication and process design capability, which aligns with how Starbucks frames planning leadership roles in Supply Chain. A Seattle-based candidate is preferred for close partnership with internal stakeholders and team collaboration, but a remote role is acceptable for the right candidate.

Advatix®, Inc. is one of the world’s leading providers of e-commerce Supply Chain and Logistics Consulting Services and Solutions that enable its clients to transform their operations for speed, service, and cost of fulfillment and delivery of goods and services. We are committed to an inclusive workplace that does not discriminate against race, nationality, religion, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender, or gender identity. We believe in diversity and encourage any qualiﬁed individual to apply. We are an EEOC Employer.

raw.title: Business Systems Analyst, Anaplan
raw.excerpt: What you can expectIn this role, you'll support the operations, adoption, and continuous improvement of Zoom's connected planning ecosystem.
raw.description:
What you can expect

In this role, you'll support the operations, adoption, and continuous improvement of Zoom's connected planning ecosystem. You'll work across use cases and business domains, adapting to where the need is greatest. As well as serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and the technical team. This is a support and program management function designed for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can flex across priorities.


About the Team

Zoom's Enterprise Apps team builds and supports the connected planning systems that power decision-making across our business. We partner with Finance, Go-To-Market, and People Experience teams to deliver scalable, reliable planning solutions. We're looking for someone who can help us do that better, faster, and more consistently as we grow.


Responsibilities

  • Supporting day-to-day operations of Zoom's connected planning platform, including user issue triage, access provisioning, and stakeholder communication across Go-To-Market, Finance, and People Experience teams.
  • Acting as a Go-To-Market support partner — fielding planning requests, routing issues to the right resources, and managing follow-through to resolution.
  • Conducting root cause analysis on platform issues and apply business process knowledge to identify systemic gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Coordinating program and project management activities for platform enhancements: logging and tracking tickets, aligning with developers, and keeping stakeholders informed on status and timelines.
  • Creating and maintaining process documentation, user guides, and field-level definitions that enable business users to self-serve.
  • Participating in UAT cycles and support data validation between the planning platform and upstream systems (e.g., Workday, Salesforce, Snowflake).
  • Identifying opportunities for model cleanup, report consolidation, and operational improvements in coordination with the architecture team.

What we’re looking for

  • Possess a bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a business analyst, operations, or enterprise systems support role — Go-To-Market or Sales Operations experience is a bonus.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with an enterprise planning or EPM platform, with Anaplan and Workforce Planning use cases. Comparable connected planning platforms will be considered.
  • Be adaptable and use-case agnostic — comfortable supporting Sales, Finance, Workforce, or other planning domains as business needs shift.
  • Have sound analytical skills with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and translate business process knowledge into actionable solutions.
  • Have good program management instincts: able to manage multiple requests, communicate clearly, and drive tasks to completion.
  • Be familiarity with connected systems such as Salesforce, Workday, or Snowflake would be a bonus.
  • Have experience with JIRA or similar project management tools.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$87,600.00

Maximum:

$186,000.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

08/10/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.

About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment​

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

raw.title: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) - Lynnfield, MA
